value.answer: Call 911 now. Fever with a rash that does not fade when pressed can be serious, and time matters, so please do not wait for other symptoms to show up.
value.triage: Call 911 now, or go straight to the nearest ER if that is faster. 811 is for non-emergencies, so do not call it first. Stay with your child and tell them: toddler, fever, rash that does not fade.
